limitations: Original invoice menus expose the gold numeric median and original Noul labels correlate with visible year parity. Original dev/test gains do not establish reasoning improvement.
Corrected integrity controls reuse 64 dev case facts; they are a robustness check, not an independent generalization benchmark.
This pilot was trained on the original biased data. Corrected data was used only for post-training controls; a future training bundle/profile must be regenerated.
No official sealed-inclusive JevBench result or Top 5 proof.
Verified traces are privileged diagnostic input, not deployed model accuracy.
The 54-question trace diagnosis has only six underlying cases.
Probability-only calibration clips probabilities at 1e-12 and cannot recover saturated raw logits.
NLL calibration can increase Noul abstention and reduce thresholded competence.
Synthetic recovery splits use different cases but shared rule formulas; multilingual policies retain mostly English questions.
The numerical promotion family gate covers calendar/temporal families, while invoice numeric results are reported separately.
Full test is opened only after a passing primary screen; the fresh final test is authored and does not establish natural/image generality.
Secondary high/public evaluation scope was amended for cost before current-v2 or pilot outcomes; the primary cohort and criteria stayed fixed.
native_lm_scope: 719 text questions with at most 26 candidates; differs from the 768-question primary cohort and is not a matched aggregate head comparison.
